title: The Cutting Edge: Week of May 17th
body:
## Highlights
- Mekyle Naidoo from EDG Builders released [EdgeApps](https://edgeware.app/), a backport fork of Polkadot Apps bringing back the contracts deployment functionality.
- Dillon Chen announced [Hedgeware, a Kusama parachain](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1153-announcing-hedgeware-a-kusama-parachain-for-edgeware) in the Edgeware ecosystem on behalf of Commonwealth Labs.
- Seedcode shared the [final community update](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1160-staking-ui-final-community-update) on Staking UI.
- Upcoming AMAs: [How To Make It in Crypto-media](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series), [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/) and [Exit Theory](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1131-exit-theory-a-content-and-community-project).


## Ecosystem Updates
**Commonwealth.im**
_The multi-chain governance and community interface. _(Join [TG](https://t.me/HiCommonwealth)/[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/watSundeFK))
- Successfully raised $3.2MM led by Dragonfly Capital and ParaFi Capital.
- Support for [Off-chain Polls](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1154-commonwealth-support-for-offchain-polls) was added to the Commonwealth Forum.
- [New Homepage](https://commonwealth.im/) is live.
- The ability to create a token community gated to token holders for any ERC20 and WalletConnect support was added.
- Introducing Omni-Search Bar: searching members, posts, forums, and communities.


**dTrade**
_dTrade is a platform for trading perpetuals and options on Edgeware. _(Join [TG](https://t.me/dTradeOfficial)/[Discord](https://discord.gg/5nKAsZy9yK))
- dTrade presented their mobile app demo in [Polkadot Decoded](https://twitter.com/dtradeorg/status/1396417077553008644?s=20).
